detail.title: 电池式液压真空吊具
detail.abstract: The utility model provides a kind of battery type hydraulic vacuum suspender comprising battery, vacuum air-channel, circuit, Suction cup assembly, sucker stand, hydraulic cylinder, control cabinet, suspender frame, hydraulic cylinder and suspender frame rotation pin, sucker stand and suspender frame rotation pin, hydraulic cylinder and sucker stand rotation pin and welding suspender plate.The suspender is using 12V DC vacuum pump as vacuum power source, and use 12V DC hydraulic station as hydraulic cylinder power source, battery is fully charged to use 8-10 hour for vacuum pump, solves the use environment of outdoor 220V 380V electricity consumption inconvenience, and do not limited by hoisting height, without being wired to suspender again from power supply.It is able to achieve carrying requirement of the client to various specifications glass board material, simple to operate, highly-safe, modularized design, operator can realize various functions according to different use conditions.
assignees: 深圳市创思泰科技有限公司
